title: Teebox
subtitle: Building a multi-brand email production platform from the ground up.

evidence.statement: ~14 average emails per week across brands
Minimum of 4 hours saved per Callaway Golf email
One master template supports four brands
The three designers supporting marketing emails can focus more on design quality and final review instead of repeated coding and troubleshooting

quickView.problem: Email production depended on manual edits, repeated handoffs, quality checks, and code troubleshooting that also took designers away from design work.
quickView.evolution: Prototyping and testing → Visual Editor → Section Builder → Multi-Brand Platform → Validation + Translation → Dual Delivery → MCP Connectors → API Connections
quickView.product: A multi-brand email production and management system that moves repeated coding into a visual workflow. One master template supports four brands, and Supabase handles the backend.
quickView.impact: Validated evidence includes a minimum of 4 hours saved per Callaway Golf email, ~14 average emails per week across brands, and a 40% file-size reduction.
quickView.learning: Automate repeated checks, not the final responsibility.
